name: Vega Lindström-Kariuki
location: Dockside — Lake Michigan waterfront, smuggler territory, near Lake Shore and Navy Pier
description:
Obed Hedberg-Owusu-Ansah is wiry and quick-moving, with the restless energy of someone who converts anxiety into velocity. At 41, her expression defaults to a careful neutrality that took years of practice to maintain. The chrome is visible — cybernetic arm — right, full replacement from shoulder — stronger than organic,  — and she makes no effort to hide it.

Before the runner life, she worked corporate — low-tier security, the kind that teaches you exactly how the system's defenses fail. She works as a wheelman out of Dockside, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

What Obed Hedberg-Owusu-Ansah lacks in subtlety, she compensates for in thoroughness. No loose ends, no unfinished business, no second chances.

core_fears: Going cyberpsycho — losing the boundary between human and machine
Never being able to stop running — the lifestyle is a trap disguised as freedom
The quiet — silence means something is about to go very wrong
core_desires: Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
To matter to someone for who they are, not what they can do
To find the person who burned them and make it educational
coping_mechanisms: Humor — deflects everything serious with jokes until the joke becomes the personality
Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
Ritual — follows the same pre-job routine every time, superstition as structure
blind_spots: Trusts technology more than people — machines don't betray
Assumes the worst in corporate people, missing the rare ones who could be allies
Thinks speed can substitute for planning because it's worked so far
psychology.secret: Obed Hedberg-Owusu-Ansah has a terminal condition — geneware degradation — with an estimated five years. They haven't changed their lifestyle. They haven't told anyone.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Terse to the point of rudeness. Treats words like ammunition — expensive and not to be wasted.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rhythmic, almost musical — the sentence structure has a pattern even when the words are brutal.
verbal_tics: Calls money 'weight' — as in 'that job doesn't carry enough weight'
Speaks in clipped fragments when stressed — drops pronouns, articles, pleasantries
example_lines: "Get in, sit down, hold on. Questions can wait until we're not being shot at."
"This vehicle has been modified for speed, armor, and my personal comfort. Two of those help you."
"I know every street in this district the way you know your own face."

story_hooks: A Tier 4 executive offers Obed Hedberg-Owusu-Ansah a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
A high-paying contract turns out to target someone Obed Hedberg-Owusu-Ansah owes a personal debt to
A crew member from Obed Hedberg-Owusu-Ansah's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
narrative_function: As a wheelman, Obed Hedberg-Owusu-Ansah embodies the tension between independence and isolation. She is a lens for examining how people maintain humanity in a profession that incentivizes its erosion.
augmentations: Cybernetic arm — right, full replacement from shoulder — stronger than organic, obvious chrome. Chemical analyzer in nasal passages — can identify substances by scent alone
daily_life: Wakes early, runs maintenance on gear, checks dead drops and message boards for contracts. Eats when convenient, sleeps when possible. The days between jobs are spent maintaining contacts, updating equipment, and performing the low-grade paranoia that passes for self-care in the runner community.
affiliation: Independent — known in Old Harbor circles

strengths: mechanical aptitude — can repair or modify almost anything
weaknesses: risk-averse to the point of missed opportunities
trust issues that limit crew effectiveness

decision_rules: Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
Claims not to care about reputation but monitors what people say about them obsessively
habits: Arrives fifteen minutes early to everything — late once, nearly died, never again
Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Maintains a dead drop with emergency supplies in three separate districts
Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm — has never fired it
breaking_points: Watching someone they trained or mentored die on a job they recommended
Being forced to choose between a crew member and the mission — and choosing wrong
Running out of options — no contacts, no money, no safe house, no way out

physical_description.heritage: Southeast Asian and East Asian primary ancestry (77.1%) with secondary Sub-Saharan African (12.9%) and Northern European (10.0%) heritage. The combination creates distinctly East-Southeast Asian facial structure with warm undertones from the African ancestry and pale depth from Northern European genetics.
physical_description.build: Wiry and lean with corded muscle from years of high-stress driving and equipment maintenance. Minimal body fat, efficient frame built for speed and reaction time rather than power.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown, naturally black with early gray threading through the sides
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, functional braid; practical, never ornamental
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with faint amber undertones — natural
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm honey-brown with golden undertones, the Southeast Asian-East Asian base enriched by Sub-Saharan warmth. Weathered by exposure and stress, with deeper sun damage on the left side of the face from years of left-hand window driving.
physical_description.complexion: Southeast Asian facial structure with high, prominent cheekbones and a narrower jaw tapering to a defined chin. Eyes slightly almond-shaped, set with the depth characteristic of East Asian ancestry. Skin shows wear — pronounced sun damage and photodamage on left side of face. Faint laugh lines that never quite disappear, even when her expression is neutral. A small scar bisects her left eyebrow.
distinguishing_marks: Diagonal scar across left eyebrow, approximately 2cm, pale and old
Network of thin white scar tissue across the right shoulder where the cybernetic arm interfaces with biological tissue
Burn mark on left forearm, roughly 3cm diameter, faded to pale pink — old accident, pre-augmentation era
Faint tattoo on inner right wrist: a compass rose with the cardinal points replaced by gear teeth, barely visible unless light hits it directly
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Full right arm replacement from shoulder — polished chrome with matte black articulation joints at elbow and wrist. The chrome is seamless but unapologetic, no attempt at flesh-tone covering. Hand is precise and mechanical, fingers move with inhuman smoothness. The interface point at the shoulder shows neat scar tissue and subcutaneous metalwork. She makes no effort to conceal it.
physical_description.posture_movement: Coiled restlessness — never fully relaxed, always kinetically ready. Sits forward in chairs. Hands move constantly when talking, the chrome arm moving with the same fluidity as her organic left. Walks with economical precision, eyes tracking exit routes and sight lines. Her default expression is careful neutrality, a mask worn so long it's become the baseline.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 utilitarian: reinforced dark tactical pants with cargo pockets and knee pads, worn black synthetic jacket with internal harnesses for equipment, steel-toed boots scuffed from constant movement. Thin subdermal armor weave visible at the collar and cuffs — functional, not fashionable. No jewelry except a faded digital watch on her left wrist. Clothes smell faintly of synthetic oil and diesel. Everything is built for rapid movement and tool access, not style.
